additional_info.subject: RE: ID0484558-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / RD 170003001] Logs' check CRM:03056001128
additional_info.body:
Hello,
Thank you for the feedback, but I am not sure we are talking about the same recharge. The customer started a recharge at 11:50:53
a.m. (cu time) on outlet n. 1. While he was charging he could not stop it.
So we advised to wait the natural end of the recharge (he was at 89% percent) and he waited till 12:34:38 p.m. (cu time). But he could not stop it between 12:20 and 12:26 p.m. (cu time).
Is it possible to understand the reason for which he could not stop the recharge?
Thank you

additional_info.subject: ID0484558-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / RD 170003001] Logs' check CRM:03056001128
additional_info.body:
Hi Filomena ,
I hope this email finds you well.
Checking the logs I could find this information regarding the charging session
Outlet 1 (DC1)
This outlet showed initial instability before successfully completing a session:
Attempt 1 (Failed): Started at 11:45:30 and stopped at 11:46:47 (Duration: 0s).
Attempt 2 (Failed): Started at 11:46:51 and stopped at 11:48:17 (Duration: 0s).
Main Session (Successful):
Start: 11:50:14 (as per the
CHARGING_SESSION_START
record).
End: 12:34:39.
Final Status: Successfully completed (Final SOC: 85%).
For more details I'm also sharing the screenshots from the logs.
• The first try, the client did on 11:45
• The charge session didn't pass the authentication and ended at 11:46:47 because the car was not ready.
• The same car tried a second time at 11:47:01
• The charge session didn't pass the authentication again because the car was not ready 11:48:17
• The session you mentioned started at 11:50:14
• This session ended at 12:34:39
Regarding this error that you mentioned, I could check the logs around 12:20 but we didn't had any issue on the logs and the car only reach 85% at 12:34, you can see on the screenshot.
With best re
gards,
eMobility Technical Support Team – Felipe Moraes
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
